$comment: World laws (docs/proposals/world-laws.md): switches the gods set during play. The first value of each is its default (no law). Read through src/sim/worldlaws.js.

values.name: On
values.about: No new war may start: no declarations and no attacks on villages not already at war. Wars already running go on to their end, and rivalry no longer sinks below neutral.

values.name: Off
values.about: People age and the old may die of old age.

values.name: On
values.about: Adults do not age and nobody dies of old age; children still grow up.

values.name: Off
values.about: Births, crops and forests come at their usual pace.

values.name: On
values.about: Births, crops, spreading forests and new daughter villages come twice as fast.

values.name: Normal
values.about: Illness comes and goes as usual.

values.name: None
values.about: Nobody falls ill; those already ill get over it.

values.name: Endless
values.about: The plague keeps breaking out, in each village about every 10 days, though a village of 3 or fewer standing is spared.

values.name: On
values.about: Wolves still hunt deer and horses, but never people, and people need not run from them.

values.name: Off
values.about: Monsters roam and sometimes come near villages.

values.name: On
values.about: Monsters stay near their lairs: no forays, no raids, and they never strike people or crops.

values.name: Off
values.about: Fire spreads through forest and wooden buildings.

values.name: On
values.about: Fire burns only what it was set on: nothing catches from a neighbour.

values.name: Endless summer
values.about: It is midsummer all year: crops grow, nobody freezes.

values.name: Endless winter
values.about: It is midwinter all year: crops wither and the cold bites.
